item.description: Release: llm-gemini 0.36 Gemini 4 Carbon was announced two weeks ago for "a subset of cyber defenders", but today it's available to everyone else .

item.title: [paper] Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
item.description: Researchers adapted the DINOv2 foundation model for medical image segmentation and found it generalized better on external datasets compared to task-specific models.

item.title: [paper] Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
item.description: Researchers introduce a student-teacher training strategy and adapt the EM-DETR framework to build a multi-domain foundation model for medical lesion detection.

item.title: [paper] TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
item.description: TorchCurves is a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives for applications like continuous feature embeddings and functional regression.

item.title: [paper] AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
item.description: AutoScaffold is an AI-for-AI framework that automatically generates and adapts training scaffolds from student experience, outperforming standard reinforcement learning baselines across four diverse domains.

item.title: [paper] Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
item.description: Contrastive Discovery replaces pointwise hypothesis testing with mutually exclusive competing explanations in LLM agents, resolving scientific questions more effectively and outperforming pointwise search.

item.title: [paper] Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
item.description: Pyrite introduces a pairwise protein-ligand pose-ranking benchmark and LLM-based agents that use structured representations and feature discovery to exceed expert performance in small-molecule drug discovery.

item.title: [paper] When Does the Real Wiring Win? Testing connectome structure-function claims against unmeasured physiology
item.description: A comparative study of connectome-constrained models reveals that tuning methodology and physiological assumptions critically impact whether biological wiring diagrams outperform shuffled null models.

item.title: [paper] Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
item.description: Continual-ARC is a lifelong evaluation stream built from ARC-AGI tasks that measures both memorization and generalization across memory-based and weight-based learning systems.

item.title: [paper] Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
item.description: Bonbon is a multimodal foundation model for molecular interactions that exhibits zero-shot emergent functional, residue, and bond capabilities from paired protein-ligand sequences.

item.title: [paper] Measuring Robustness and Efficiency in a Connectome-Constrained Fly Visual System Model: Linking an Adversarial and a Perceptual Illusion
item.description: FlyNet is a connectome-constrained neural network model of the fly visual system that achieves high computational efficiency and robust collision detection compared to standard artificial neural networks.

item.title: [paper] RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval
item.description: RS-JEPA is a compact joint-embedding predictive architecture using Vision Mamba encoders and scan-path views to achieve effective cross-sensor remote sensing image retrieval.

item.title: [paper] Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
item.description: A three-phase comparative study of enterprise analytics agent evaluation frameworks demonstrates that trace-based evaluation and adversarial red-teaming provide complementary detection of failures.

item.title: [paper] ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
item.description: ReTrace distills natural language standard operating procedures and logged agent runs into efficient, reusable programmatic workflows that lower cost and latency while maintaining high task completion rates.

item.title: [paper] TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
item.description: TimeSeek is a generalized time series model that combines multi-domain feature extraction and multi-task collaborative training to improve performance across diverse forecasting and anomaly detection tasks.

item.title: [paper] Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
item.description: Re-Search is an evaluation framework based on Twenty Questions that tracks how large language models explore research ideas, revealing that generation is the primary bottleneck in automated ideation.

item.title: [paper] Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference
item.description: This paper establishes five principles and a recursive logic of inference to improve how mechanistic interpretability identifies and validates neural network computations.

item.title: [paper] Pterodactyl: Pushing the Limits of Efficient Automated Translation Evaluation
item.description: Pterodactyl is an ultra-low-cost automated translation evaluation system designed for binary classification tasks like segment-level quality scoring and error-free detection using an LLM-as-a-judge approach.

item.title: [paper] FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking
item.description: FERN is a table retrieval system for Text-to-SQL tasks that combines frozen retrievers with a LightGBM ranker to efficiently select relevant database tables without using generative large language models.

item.title: [paper] BoviShift: A Six-Year Multi-Attribute Audit of Visual Cattle Phenotyping Across Animals and Time
item.description: BoviShift is a six-year visual cattle dataset and evaluation framework that assesses computer vision model performance across changing animal cohorts, breeds, and time.

item.title: [paper] TanCRAFT: Context-Reasoned Anticipatory Feedback for Assembly Tasks
item.description: TanCRAFT is a real-time predictive assistance system that tracks assembly state, forecasts motion, and provides contextual feedback to prevent human errors during physical tasks.

item.title: [paper] C$^2$-Routing: Complementary Cropping and Compression for Efficient Vision-Language Inference
item.description: C2-Routing is an adaptive vision-language inference method that combines image cropping, compression, and a safety gate to reduce computational overhead while preserving accuracy across diverse tasks.

item.title: [paper] Bayesian inverse problems and epidemic-threshold uncertainty for a heterogeneous SIS reaction-diffusion model
item.description: This paper uses Bayesian inference and a uniform second-order expansion to analyze epidemic thresholds and parameter uncertainty in early observations of a heterogeneous SIS reaction-diffusion model.

item.title: [paper] A Theory of Policy Optimization in Post-Training: Coverage Collapse and Reference Resets
item.description: This paper identifies coverage collapse in language model policy optimization and introduces reference resets within Approximate Policy Mirror Descent to guarantee global convergence.

item.title: [paper] One Curve, Different Weights: AUC, the Brier Score, Decision-Weighted AUC, and the Policy Youden Index
item.description: Weighted AUC, or AUC_pi, is proposed as a risk score summary that weighs observation pairs based on a decision maker's probability of acting to consistently evaluate models.

item.title: [paper] A Theory of Cross-Validation Variance
item.description: A finite-sample identity for cross-validation variance is proven, showing that K-fold and leave-pair-out schemes are variance optimal at first order.

item.title: [paper] Accurate predictions of properties of energetic materials with tabular foundation models
item.description: Tabular foundation model TabPFN is shown to outperform tuned machine learning models in predicting impact sensitivity, decomposition temperature, and crystal density of energetic materials.

item.title: [paper] When does text encoding matter for language modeling?
item.description: A hybrid text encoding scheme named Aether is proposed to evaluate how text encoding strategies impact the performance of byte-level language models across diverse languages.

item.title: [paper] A Lightweight Differentiable Method for Real-Time Skin Rendering and Digitization
item.description: A differentiable screen-space subsurface scattering framework is introduced for real-time skin rendering and digitization using lightweight, single-view inputs.

item.title: [paper] Nonparametric Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Mixtures of Logistic Regressions
item.description: A sieve nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator is analyzed for mixtures of logistic regressions to model binary responses with unobserved heterogeneity.

item.title: [paper] UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
item.description: Unified Generative Geometry Model jointly models RGB video, depth, and camera pose to improve 4D scene understanding and visual generation.

item.title: [paper] Metric-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization for Explainable Deepfake Detection
item.description: Metric-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization is applied to train a vision-language model pipeline for explainable deepfake detection.

item.title: [paper] One Policy for 100 Household Tasks: Our Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
item.description: A single vision-language-action model trained on 211 million frames is demonstrated to handle 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator.

item.title: [paper] Two Communities, One Problem: Branch-and-Bound vs. A* for Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling
item.description: A graph-based A* search method is shown to substantially outperform branch-and-bound variants when applied to resource-constrained project scheduling problems.

item.title: [paper] Quantifying the Sampling Frequency Invariance of Time-Series Foundation Models for Sensor Data Applications
item.description: Stress-test study of four prominent time-series foundation models that quantifies their sampling frequency invariance and reveals how performance degradation under lower frequencies reflects information loss.

item.title: [paper] DnNP: Denoising Input Uncertainty in Neural Processes
item.description: Denoising Neural Processes extend the neural process framework using variational inference to explicitly model input uncertainty, significantly improving prediction and uncertainty quantification on noisy datasets.

item.title: [paper] Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters
item.description: Earlybird is a 29M-parameter streaming speech recognizer that predicts words accurately before speakers finish them, enabling faster response times for voice agents.

item.title: [paper] OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models
item.description: Label-free contrastive adaptation framework that extracts action representations from pretrained foundation models for video world models without requiring a reconstruction bottleneck.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
item.description: Evaluation of five language models on generating formal world models as partially observable stochastic games, finding that mechanical validity does not guarantee structural agreement for downstream reasoning.

item.title: [paper] Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
item.description: Method that dynamically escalates weight precision from 4 bits to 8 bits only at uncertain decoding steps in small local language models to optimize memory and accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Exploring Post-Hoc Disentanglement of Audio Foundation Models for Music Similarity
item.description: Study on post-hoc disentanglement of audio foundation models using conditional similarity networks with frozen pretrained embeddings to improve attribute-specific music similarity and retrieval.

item.title: [news] Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data
item.description: Suite of collaborative tools that lets teams brainstorm, build spreadsheets, and share dashboards directly with Claude.

item.title: [paper] Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
item.description: Investigation comparing weight precision reductions and option-order averaging for small local language models, providing cost-matched guidelines for spending a fixed inference budget.

item.title: [paper] Causal Concept Explanations for Deep Neural Models
item.description: Causal Concept Wrapper Network uses interventional mediation analysis to align concept-based explanations with neural model outputs, ensuring explanations are necessary, sufficient, and independent.

item.title: [paper] Discovering Equations for the Thermodynamics of South Asian Monsoon Precipitation
item.description: Symbolic distillation approach combining neural networks and symbolic regression to discover interpretable closed-form equations for South Asian monsoon precipitation from reanalysis data.

item.title: [paper] REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
item.description: REAL Loss is a training loss for speculative decoding that directly optimizes real expected acceptance length using path weights and Rao-Blackwellization, improving language model inference speed without architectural changes.

item.title: [paper] A Margin Perspective on LoRA: Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting and Adapter Merging (MaLoRA)
item.description: A margin-based perspective on LoRA provides a theoretical explanation for its robustness to catastrophic forgetting and adapter merging by showing optimal adapters align with max-margin solutions.

item.title: [paper] Blurring the Block Boundaries: Overlapping Block Denoising for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
item.description: Blurring the Block Boundaries is a training-free acceleration method for diffusion language models that refines two blocks in parallel within a shared forward pass, improving latency-quality trade-offs.

item.title: [paper] An Energy-Based Perspective on Machine Learning
item.description: This tutorial frames energy-based models as a unifying lens that connects diverse machine learning paradigms through their choice of energy function, inference procedure, and learning method.

item.title: [paper] Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models
item.description: This paper proposes a Cognitive Learning by Thinking Framework that maps human-like insight acquisition mechanisms onto computational processes in large language models and analyzes their structural failure modes.
